subject: Re: Fast Weight Layers kickoff — long-doc quality
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing: Gustavo 60% (implementation lead), Quentin 50% (evals), Chiara 40% (integration glue).

Budget: sorted. Idris verbally earmarked $180k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-85 for this project — that covers the long-doc sweeps and the ablation grid (FWL size, attn_chunks, vocab handling) with margin. I am planning Q3 against that number and will chase the written confirmation when the cycle opens.

Technical choice to make early: the release ships both a TensorFlow implementation (subclassing tf.keras.layers.Layer) and a JAX one (a flax.linen.Module), and the JAX path is flagged as not thoroughly tested. Gustavo will evaluate both.

Bruno
